audit.score_purity: The production _score_bank implementation reads its inputs and planning wind, returns a local score, and does not write controller state. The clear return preserves production output/diagnostics while skipping the eleven alternate-bank score calls.
audit.subclass_limit: A subclass overriding _score_bank with observable side effects would see fewer calls; the equivalence claim covers the concrete production controller plus test-only call counting.
